desc: Verify the reachability claim rigorously: prove (1) mirroring a single tree is achievable, (2) adjacent transposition with no residual flips is achievable, hence all permutations × independent orientations are reachable; and prove the converse (only such strings are reachable) via an invariant on the mirror-class multiset of children at every node.

Derive the counting formula precisely: per node, factor = multinomial(m_total; m_1..m_k over mirror-classes) × prod over non-symmetric classes of 2^{m_i}; total answer = product over all nodes (including the virtual root of the forest).

Design exact (collision-free) canonical IDs: parse S via stack into a forest; bottom-up assign each node id = dict[tuple of children ids], mirror id = dict[tuple of reversed children mirror-ids]; symmetric iff id == mirror-id.
Implement: iterative stack parse O(N), post-order ID assignment, per-node factor computation with precomputed factorials/inverse factorials mod 998244353, multiply all factors.
Handle edge cases (empty children, single node, fully symmetric trees like `(())`, deep nesting N=5000 — avoid recursion or set recursion limit) and mentally verify samples: `(())()` → 2, `()` → 1.
Finalize code: fast I/O, O(N) expected time/memory, output answer mod 998244353.
